sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. Applicability boundaries and evidence are guarded correctly, all declared operands, relationships, controlled alternatives, result terms, owners, datatypes, and units are represented, and the direct maximum-power comparison has the correct inclusive direction without attempting to reconstruct the informational complex formula.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicable readiness branch: do not require upperIceWaterlineLength on the lower-ice-waterline node; require the lower node only for its lower-draught resistance, and require both upperIceWaterlineLength and upperIceWaterlineBreadth on the upper-ice-waterline node, since L and B are UIWL inputs for both calculations. Also constrain the declared table-selection inputs to the canonical alternatives: propellerCount 1, 2, or 3, propellerPitchControlType controllablePitch or fixedPitch, and propulsionSystemType conventionalPropulsionSystem, electricPropulsionMachinery, or hydraulicPropulsionMachinery. Keep the complex-readiness boundary: do not add a reconstructed nonlinear formula, but retain all operands, relationships, applicability evidence, result terms, units, and the direct mcr >= both externally calculated result checks.

REVERSAL: The supplied canonical ownership metadata makes brashIceChannelResistanceAtLowerIceWaterline and brashIceChannelResistanceAtUpperIceWaterline ship-owned, so reverse the earlier nesting instruction and place both resistance quantities directly on the targeted ship; retain the waterline nodes for the waterline-owned length and breadth inputs. Also repair the sh:or non-applicable branch: it currently succeeds when the applicability condition is true, allowing missing readiness inputs to pass. Make that branch succeed only when constructionStageDate is before 2003-09-01 or iceClass is outside IA Super, IA, IB, and IC, while the applicable branch retains all required operands, relationships, units, result terms, and the direct mcr >= both-results check.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. Applicability boundaries and evidence are guarded correctly, all declared operands, relationships, controlled alternatives, result terms, owners, datatypes, and units are represented, and the direct maximum-power comparison has the correct inclusive direction without attempting to reconstruct the informational complex formula.
